title: 第580章 战斗结束金仙中期第579章 死战鲲鹏鲲鹏殒落
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
河图洛书的光芒如同退潮般迅速敛去。
只留下原地一片。
被黑白法则洗刷过的冻土。
那层地面光滑如镜。
表面所有的碎石、冰屑。
尘土都被彻底抹平。
如同一块被水冲刷了千百年的石板。
陆压站在那片光滑地面的边缘。
手中的光芒已经彻底消散。
但他的左臂微微垂着。
指尖不自觉地蜷曲了一下。
嘴角那道极淡的血痕还没完全干涸。
他没有立刻动，只是安静地站着。
看着那片空白区域。
然后那片空白区域动了。
一声极其低沉的。
如同深渊底部传来的回响。
从地面下方缓缓升起。
紧接着，整片光滑如镜的地面。
从中心开始龟裂。

裂纹以一种不规则的。
如同根系蔓延般的姿态向四周延伸。
发出密集而持续的咔嚓声。
一股浓稠到近乎实质的。
灰黑色阴气从裂纹中喷涌而出。
如同被压在地底的泉水找到了出口。
疯狂地向上翻涌！
“他没走！”
李玄的弓再次抬起。
箭尖指向那片正在龟裂的地面中央。
“他是在被河图洛书压住的瞬间。”
“把自己打进了地底！”
“吼！！！”
一声穿透地壳与空气的。
带着金属质感的嘶吼从地底深处传来。
震得整片冻土都在微微颤抖。
紧接着，一道巨大到令人窒息的黑影。
从裂开的地面下猛然升起。
如同一座沉睡在冻土层中的山峦。
被硬生生托举而出。
content_en:
The light of Hetu Luoshu quickly faded away like the ebbing tide.
Only the same place was left.
The frozen soil washed by the law of black and white.
The ground was as smooth as a mirror.
All gravel and ice chips on the surface.
The dust was completely smoothed away.
Like a stone slab that has been washed away by water for thousands of years.
Lu Ya stood on the edge of the smooth ground.
The light in his hand has completely dissipated.
But his left arm hung slightly.
The fingertips curled up unconsciously.
The very faint blood stain at the corner of his mouth has not completely dried up.
He didn't move immediately, just stood quietly.
Look at that empty space.
Then that empty space moved.
An extremely low sound.
Like an echo from the bottom of an abyss.
Slowly rising from below the ground.
Then, the entire ground was as smooth as a mirror.
Cracks start in the center.
The cracks are irregular.
It stretches out in all directions like a spreading root system.
There is a dense and continuous clicking sound.
One that was so thick that it was almost substantial.
Gray-black Yin Qi spurted out from the cracks.
It's like a spring that was suppressed underground and found its outlet.
Surge upwards like crazy!
"He didn't leave!"
Li Xuan raised his bow again.
The tip of the arrow points to the center of the cracking ground.
"The moment he was suppressed by Hetuluoshu."
"Drive yourself into the ground!"
"Roar!!!"
A sound that penetrated the earth's crust and air.
A metallic roar came from deep underground.
The shock caused the entire frozen soil to tremble slightly.
Then, a huge and suffocating black shadow appeared.
Rising suddenly from beneath the cracked ground.
Like a mountain sleeping in the frozen soil.
He was forcefully lifted out.
